title: Entity screenshots
responsibility: Displays recorded screenshots with scenario selection and comparison context. Retained focused captures are labelled separately and remain available without a full verdict.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.options
inputs.description: Available visual scenarios and viewports. Overview uses the fixed page preview, or the first declared scenario and state.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.evidence
inputs.description: Required captures/comparison mode and incomparability reasons.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.scope
inputs.description: Required commit/parent context for labels and links.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required prefix concatenated with screenshot files.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation to tests or selected-commit view.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.reasons
inputs.description: Required recorded change reasons, shown for paired comparisons with original text available.

inputs.name: EntityScreens.preview
inputs.description: Exact optional scenario, state and initial viewport declared for this page. Viewport buttons preserve its scenario and state.

outputs.name: EntityScreens
outputs.description: Concise screenshot heading, viewport buttons, capture origin and full-size viewer. No scenario/state selectors or current-commit action. Validated unchanged captures retain their original commit; rejected or absent captures remain explicit gaps.
